thread:
mira: Heads up — warm-pool nodes in eu-west-2 are failing to join since 09:07. Kubelet logs show secrets fetch errors.
devon: seeing 403 when hitting keystore-eu from warmpool-subnet. Also auditshipper POSTs returning 502s.
oliver: any recent network hardening? I remember a change to reduce egress blast radius last deploy.
devon: pushed a subnet-level default-deny last night to lock down outbound in prod-eu (MR infra#850). It scoped to known endpoints but warmpool-subnet wasn't in the allowlist.
mira: that explains it — nodes can't pull instance credentials, cannot decrypt KMS-encrypted data -> containerd won't start. This starves GPU onboarding.
sre-oncall: created INC-2026-0119 and pinging security. Can we expedite a short-lived exception? :warning:
oliver: prefer adding a narrow security-group egress for keystore-eu.internal:443 and logs-eu:9411 from subnet-0b2c3d4e, rather than reverting the whole default-deny.
devon: I can apply a terraform patch with a 30m TTL tag on the rule. Preparing tf plan now.
infra-bot: terraform plan for module vpc-egress-sg started (plan id tf-2026-05-03-09:18)
mira: also seeing KMS STS denies referencing aws:SourceVpc condition. Did the IAM condition rollout include the new warmpool subnet?
devon: nope — the conditional-authz config used tag:vpc=prod-eu but the new warmpool VPC was tagged after the change. Grants rejected.
oliver: quick fix: add explicit subnet ARN to the IAM condition for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gpu-warmup or temporarily remove the condition for that role. Security, thoughts?
sre-oncall: security approves temporary role exception for 1 hour if we document and follow up with preflight tests. Create audit flow log export to s3 for 09:00-09:20 window.
mira: running: `aws logs create-export-task --task-name flow-euw2-6510000123 --from 1683092400000 --to 1683092580000 --destination ops-audit --destination-prefix temp/6510000123`
devon: applied SG allow rule with annotation `ttl=30m;owner=devon` and ran `terraform apply`. Plan succeeded.
infra-bot: apply complete for tf-2026-05-03-09:22.
oliver: after SG change, restart warmup agent on affected nodes: `for n in $(kubectl get nodes -l warmpool=true -o name); do kubectl delete pod -n infra $(kubectl get pods -n infra -o name --field-selector spec.nodeName=$(basename $n)); done`
mira: joins recovering — dashboard shows join rate back to normal over 6m.
sre-oncall: capturing timeline and root cause: i) egress default-deny deployed without warmpool subnet in allowlist, ii) IAM conditional-authz tightened before tags propagated, iii) explicit deny led to KMS decrypt and auditshipper failures -> warmpool starved.
devon: action items: 1) add preflight hook verifying role conditions include new subnets, 2) maintain roles->subnets mapping in infra repo, 3) implement ephemeral allowlist helper for safe short-term exceptions, 4) cost check: audit ingestion link to egress cost if allowlist remains broad.
oliver: PR for IAM condition fix: gitlab.com/redwood/iam-config/merge_requests/912 (includes unit test overlay).
mira: will follow up with a one-pager for runbooks and put alert on warm-pool join latency (>3m) to SLOs. Closing INC-2026-0119 once SG rule removed.
sre-oncall: marking incident stabilized, removing temporary SG in 28m timer. :white_check_mark:
file_description: Slack thread: warm-pool GPU nodes blocked from onboarding due to VPC egress default-deny and IAM conditional-authz mismatch; temporary SG exception, terraform apply, KMS/STS denies, flow log export, runbook and cost follow-ups.
